title: About Sivakasi Crackers
content:
## Company Overview
Sivakasi Crackers is a premier fireworks and cracker retailer operating directly from Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu—the fireworks capital of India. We offer direct-from-factory pricing with discounts up to 80% off maximum retail prices (MRP) on authentic, certified green crackers.

title: About Sivakasi Crackers
content:
## Licensing and Green Cracker Certification
- All our fireworks are 100% compliant with the Supreme Court of India directives and Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organization (PESO) regulations.
- We exclusively manufacture and stock CSIR-NEERI certified Green Crackers that produce 30-35% less particulate matter emissions and are free from hazardous barium compounds.
- Every cracker box includes the official green logo and authentic NEERI QR code for instant authentication.

content:

title: Cracker Types and Product Guide
content: # Cracker Types and Product Guide

title: Cracker Types and Product Guide
content:
## 1. Sparklers (Kambi Mathappu)
- Traditional hand-held festive sparklers available in 10cm, 12cm, 15cm, and 30cm lengths.
- Varieties: Gold Electric, Bright Red, Emerald Green, and Multi-Color Color-Changing Sparklers.
- Best for: Families, children (under supervision), and puja celebrations.

title: Cracker Types and Product Guide
content:
## 2. Flower Pots (Kottai / Pookatti)
- Cone-shaped fountains emitting cascading sparks in vibrant silver, gold, and multi-colored stars.
- Varieties: Small, Big, Special, Giant, Deluxe, Tri-Color, and 5-stage Color-Changing Flower Pots.
- Safe clearance: Minimum 5 meters radius outdoors on flat level ground.

title: Cracker Types and Product Guide
content:
## 3. Ground Chakkars (Tharai Chakkaram)
- Fast-spinning horizontal wheel crackers creating circular rings of brilliant sparks.
- Varieties: Chakkar Special, Chakkar Deluxe, Rolling Wheel, and Whistling Chakkars.
- Placement: Light on smooth concrete or open asphalt ground.

title: Cracker Types and Product Guide
content:
## 4. Aerial Shots & Sky Cakes (Vaanavedi)
- Repeating multi-shot fireworks tubes that launch into the night sky and burst into colorful peonies, palms, brocades, and crackling willow effects.
- Varieties: 12-shot, 30-shot, 60-shot, 120-shot, and 240-shot Mega Sky Cakes.
- Safety: Place upright, secure carton sides with stones or bricks, light fuse from arm's length, and maintain 15 meters clear overhead clearance away from trees and buildings.

title: Cracker Types and Product Guide
content:
## 5. Sound Crackers & Bombs
- Traditional high-energy festival sound crackers.
- Varieties: Hydro Bomb, King of King, Bullet Bomb, 28 Chorsa, Bijili Crackers, and 1000/5000/10000 Garland Walas.
- Strict limit: All sound crackers manufactured in compliance with 125 decibel safety thresholds at 4 meters distance.

title: Cracker Types and Product Guide
content:
## 6. Ready-Made Family Packages & Gift Boxes
- Pre-curated assortments designed for families and apartments with balanced varieties of sparklers, pots, chakkars, aerials, and sound crackers at bundled wholesale rates.

title: Shipping and Regional Road Transport Delivery Policy
content: # Shipping and Regional Road Transport Delivery Policy

title: Shipping and Regional Road Transport Delivery Policy
content:
## 1. Statutory Road Transport Requirement
Under Indian Central Motor Vehicles Rules and Explosives Cargo Rules, fireworks are classified as hazardous Class 1 goods.
- Standard courier and air cargo services (e.g., Blue Dart, DTDC, India Post, Delhivery) strictly forbid transporting fireworks.
- Therefore, all shipments are fulfilled via licensed regional commercial road transport carriers (such as VRL Logistics, ARC, TAT, Rathimeena, Royal Transport, etc.).

title: Shipping and Regional Road Transport Delivery Policy
content:
## 2. Fulfillment Model: Nearest City Godown Pickup
- **Godown Pickup (Primary Model)**: Consignments arrive at the licensed transport operator's parcel booking office / godown nearest to your provided address.
- Customers collect their parcel upon presenting their Lorry Receipt (LR) tracking number and a valid government photo ID.
- **Local Door Delivery**: In certain metro cities and towns, local door delivery via transport auto/van can be requested directly from the destination transport hub for a nominal local handling fee.

title: Shipping and Regional Road Transport Delivery Policy
content:
## 3. Minimum Order Values for Factory Dispatch
- **Tamil Nadu & Pondicherry**: Minimum order value is ₹3,000 for direct transport booking.
- **Other Indian States**: Minimum order value is ₹5,000 due to interstate transport manifest mandates.
- Orders below these amounts cannot be manifested by regional road transport hubs.

title: Shipping and Regional Road Transport Delivery Policy
content:
## 4. Estimated Transit Durations
- **Tamil Nadu & Pondicherry**: 24 to 48 hours from dispatch.
- **South India (Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana)**: 3 to 5 business days.
- **Rest of India**: 5 to 8 business days depending on distance and highway permits.

title: Shipping and Regional Road Transport Delivery Policy
content:
## 5. Lorry Receipt (LR) Tracking
Once your shipment is handed over to the road transport carrier in Sivakasi, a stamped physical or digital Lorry Receipt (LR copy) is generated. We send your LR number via WhatsApp and SMS within 24 hours of booking, allowing you to track the lorry's arrival at your city depot.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content: # Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content: ## General & Safety

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content:
### Q1: Are your crackers safe and legal?
Yes. All products sold by Sivakasi Crackers are 100% legal, certified Green Crackers licensed by PESO and developed under CSIR-NEERI formulations. They do not contain banned heavy chemicals such as Barium Nitrate, Lead, or Antimony.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content:
### Q2: Are there crackers suitable for young children?
Yes! Our "Children Collection" and "Sparklers" include low-decibel, high-visual novelty items such as Electric Sparklers (red, green, gold), Flower Pots (Color Changing, Special Ashoka), Ground Chakkars, Magic Pop, and Colorful Whistling Fountains that are child-friendly under adult supervision.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content:
### Q3: How should I store crackers until Diwali?
Keep crackers in a cool, dry, and well-ventilated area away from direct sunlight, stoves, electrical heaters, open flames, and moisture. Store them inside their original moisture-resistant packaging.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content: ## Ordering & Logistics

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content:
### Q4: How do I place an order?
You have two easy ways:
1. **Explore Crackers**: Browse our visual 2-column mobile / 4-column desktop store, filter by category, and add items to your basket.
2. **Quick Order List ⚡**: Use our wholesale price list table to type quantities (`5`, `10`, etc.) and view live line amounts and grand totals.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content:
### Q5: What is the minimum order requirement?
The minimum booking threshold for regional road transport is:
- **₹3,000** for delivery in Tamil Nadu & Pondicherry.
- **₹5,000** for delivery to all other Indian states.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content:
### Q6: Can I get crackers delivered directly to my home doorstep?
Most orders arrive at your local road transport office (Godown Pickup). When the parcel reaches your city depot, the transport office calls you. You can either pick it up directly or request them to dispatch it via a local auto/van for a small local transport charge.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content:
### Q7: When should I order before Diwali to avoid rush?
We strongly advise ordering 2 to 3 weeks prior to Diwali. During the final 10 days before Diwali, road transport hubs experience severe festival traffic and freight backlogs.

title: Payment Terms & Verification Policy
content: # Payment Terms & Verification Policy

title: Payment Terms & Verification Policy
content:
## 1. Supported Payment Modes
We provide direct and secure festival payment channels:
- **Instant UPI QR & Virtual Payment Address (VPA)**: Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, and bank UPI apps.
- **Direct Bank Transfer (NEFT / RTGS / IMPS)**: Direct electronic settlement into our authorized current business bank account.
- **Cash on Delivery (COD)**: Due to road transport logistics regulations for hazardous goods, COD is **not supported** by freight carriers. Full payment is required prior to factory packaging and dispatch.

title: Payment Terms & Verification Policy
content:
## 2. Order Confirmation Workflow
1. Customer submits order details via online checkout.
2. An official public Order Reference ID (e.g., `CR2026-XXXX`) is issued.
3. Customer completes the UPI payment or bank transfer using the Order ID as transaction reference.
4. Transaction reference screenshot or UTR number is shared with our dispatch desk on WhatsApp.
5. Our staff verifies the bank credit and transitions the order status to `Confirmed` and `Packing`.

title: Payment Terms & Verification Policy
content:
## 3. Pricing & Discounts
- All product listings display the manufacturer Maximum Retail Price (MRP) struck out alongside the direct Sivakasi factory discounted price (up to 80% discount).
- The quoted prices are exclusive of local freight charges, which are payable at the godown upon pickup according to lorry weight parcel tariffs (typically ₹150 - ₹350 per standard carton).

title: Return & Damaged Consignment Policy
content: # Return & Damaged Consignment Policy

title: Return & Damaged Consignment Policy
content:
## 1. Safety Regulatory Restrictions on Returns
Under the Indian Explosives Act, commercial fireworks **cannot be re-shipped or returned via ordinary parcel transit** once delivered to a retail customer. Consequently, standard e-commerce reverse pickups are not permissible under safety laws.

title: Return & Damaged Consignment Policy
content:
## 2. Damage or Shortage Claims
If any carton arrives visibly damaged or items are missing:
1. **Mandatory Unboxing Video**: You must record a continuous, unedited video while unboxing the carton, showing the outer transport seal, LR bill, and inner cracker boxes.
2. **Notification Window**: Notify our customer support desk within **24 hours** of collecting the consignment from the transport godown.
3. **Resolution**: Upon review of the unboxing evidence, we provide an immediate pro-rata monetary refund or a voucher credit for the damaged or missing boxes.
